prompt: The dwarven door in the hillside from outside, standing open, three figures emerging into flat grey daylight and thin rain, blinking, the wet green valley spread out below them
motion: They step out one at a time and stop. Rain falls on their faces. One of them turns to look back at the dark doorway. Slow push in on the open door.
say: It was still raining. It had been raining for three days. It had never looked better.
sfx: Rain on hillside, wind, birds, a stone door settling, breathing
